correctness.rationale: PASS: Each cyclic matrix realizes the F_q[t]/(f) cyclic module. Every invariant submodule of such a module is uniquely indexed by a monic divisor; the characteristic polynomial on a prefix of a complete invariant flag uniquely specifies the submodule. Thus any similarity between two matrices with equal ordered diagonal must preserve all flag prefixes and is upper triangular. Every diagonal word has a cyclic representative by linking positions of each repeated eigenvalue into one Jordan chain. The full centralizer is F_q[A], whose invertible unit group has q^(n-k)(q-1)^k elements and, since A is triangular, lies in the Borel group. Orbit-stabilizer proves the formula, Stirling partitions count words by k, and binomial EGF/term j=q gives asymptotic (q/(q-1))^q((q-1)/q)^n. Independent direct matrix-power-rank enumeration verified every fixed diagonal word for q=2,n=3 (28 cyclic matrices), q=2,n=4 (240), q=3,n=3 (522). These exhaustive bounded values corroborate only the general algebraic proof.

value.rationale: PASS: A complete flag-preserving matrix algebra is a canonical finite-dimensional algebra distinct from the full and maximal-parabolic matrix spaces. Exact Borel-conjugacy classes for all cyclic matrices, stabilizer orders, a Stirling distribution and exponential density supply natural representation and finite-field matrix-invariant data beyond the classical one-Jordan-block case.

final_claim: Over every F_q (q prime power) and n>=1, cyclic upper triangular n-by-n matrices with a fixed ordered diagonal word d (k distinct entries) form one invertible-upper-triangular conjugacy orbit of size q^(binom(n,2)-n+k)(q-1)^(n-k) and stabilizer size q^(n-k)(q-1)^k. Summing by Stirling occupancy yields P_{n,q}=q^(-n) sum_k(q)_k S(n,k)((q-1)/q)^(n-k), EGF and its fixed-q exponential asymptotic.
limitations: Only cyclic matrices under full invertible upper-triangular conjugation, not all noncyclic Borel orbits or unitriangular action.
